title: Janitor merges produce silently-broken union text (schc_failure_tracker CMakeLists case)
description: The merge janitor's textual conflict resolution concatenated two variants of lichen/tests/schc_failure_tracker/CMakeLists.txt into a 48-line file with duplicate cmake_minimum_required/project/add_executable/add_test blocks — git-clean but cmake-broken ('add_executable cannot create target', duplicate add_test). Landed on main via a worker-branch merge despite the correct 28-line dual-mode version already being in main's history (ec10c9e609). Fixed on beads-worker-6 as 270f1c4679 (restored 28-line version; host ctest + Zephyr native_sim build/run both green). Systemic ask: janitor should run a cheap post-merge smoke (e.g. cmake configure of changed test dirs, or at least flag files whose post-merge line count exceeds both parents) before landing. Found while working dbbn.
close_reason: Restored the single dual-mode CMake definition, verified sanitized host configure/build/ctest (1/1 passed), and completed manual correctness/security/edge reviews after delegated Kimi reviews were unavailable due insufficient credits.
